svg.title: 370 contributions in the past year
svg.desc: Isometric 3D chart of dhruvag14's GitHub contributions between two seas. Each day is a tower whose height follows its contribution count. A giant lizard kaiju rises from the sea at random spots, shakes the ground, crumbles blocks of towers into smoke, and shoots down helicopters with a blue-purple breath; once per loop it goes berserk and sweeps a 360-degree beam that levels the whole city before it rebuilds. Longest streak 11 days, 63 active days, best day 37 on 30 Oct.
